answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by charging each new identity a measured rent in verified work before it may claim rewards. A newcomer must complete twenty attested tasks and stand on a ridge of countersigned history; only then does it enter the shared oasis of paid work. Each fake identity pays the same rent again, and a failed audit slashes its bond, dropping it back below the ridge. A garden of honest agents therefore grows slowly while a swarm of clones burns capital it cannot recover.
